text:
maria-marketing: quick sync — finalizing release post + benchmarks. need: final changelog snippet, docs url, and canary rollout window. can we align on messaging and webinar CTA? :eyes:

sam-eng: docs PR merged yesterday, link in thread below. canary slot open thursday morning PT, want to reserve 2 hours for monitoring.

jonah-docs: pushing the canonical docs link now: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/v2.3.0 — will add 'what's new' bullets and example prompts by EOD.

lee-product: webinar planned week after launch (weds). marketing wants to send save-the-date right after announce. can we confirm final rollout percentage and fallbacks?

sam-eng: proposed rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 3 waves with automatic rollback on error rate >0.5%. canary starts 03/30 10:00 PT, wave 2 midday, full by 03/31 evening.

maria-marketing: ok that timeline works for comms. we want a 1-line changelog in the social post + link to full changelog in docs. jonah can you surface most customer-facing items?

jonah-docs: yes — I'll extract three bullets: "improved batching heuristics for 20-40% cost reduction", "new model routing fallback for latency spikes", "CLI: redesigned deploy flags". I'll also add a permalink to the full changelog page.

sam-eng: note on the batching bullet: prefer wording "recommended batching defaults updated" so we don't promise exact percent. ops will add a benchmark note in the blog post.

maria-marketing: good call — change to "recommended batching defaults updated (see benchmarks)". for social copy: short headline + link to blog with benchmark narrative + webinar CTA.

lee-product: on inbound leads — marketing, set route: webinar signups -> sales-marketing queue; docs feedback -> product-qa. we can add a hidden utm param for canary testers so we can track early adopters.

maria-marketing: perfect. sam, can you and eng-oncall add a lightweight debug flag for canary users so we can capture perf samples (opt-in)?

sam-eng: yes, will add opt-in header X-RW-Collect: canary to capture samples. we'll coordinate with privacy/legal.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for release/v2.3.0 at 2026-03-30T17:00:00Z (canary region: us-west-2).

maria-marketing: sweet — i'll draft the announce copy and share in this thread for a quick engineering/legal pass before we publish. aim to publish announce + blog + docs link 30 minutes after canary is healthy. :rocket:

jonah-docs: I'll ping legal on the benchmarks language now. expect updated docs permalink in ~2 hours.

sam-eng: oncall will be in standby during the 2-hour canary window. please DM any ASAP changes to me.

maria-marketing: thanks all — I'll post the draft here in 30. :thumbsup:
